summary: Local coverage of Purkazi is thin; the district-level complaints that dominate are unpaid sugarcane dues, weak power for irrigation, sugarcane prices and overloaded cane trucks, while the only Purkazi-specific appreciation found is its 2019 ODF Plus status.
identity_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Purqazi_Assembly_constituency (Constituency No. 13, district Muzaffarnagar, reservation SC, Bijnor Lok Sabha)

positives.english: Purkazi nagar panchayat got ODF Plus status and its community toilet is in good shape
positives.hindi: पुरकाजी नगर पंचायत को ओडीएफ प्लस का दर्जा मिला, सामुदायिक शौचालय ठीक हैं
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (Meerut bureau, 23 Feb 2019): Purkaji Nagar Panchayat declared ODF Plus after a 16 January inspection; no open defecation found; community toilet in good condition. The only nagar panchayat in the district to get the status. Dated 2019, so may be stale.

positives.english: * Being on the Delhi-Dehradun highway (NH 58) makes travel to Delhi and Haridwar easier
positives.hindi: * दिल्ली-देहरादून हाईवे (NH 58) पर होने से दिल्ली और हरिद्वार आना-जाना आसान है
positives.basis: Inference: Wikipedia states Purkazi is on NH 58, the Delhi-Dehradun highway, and borders Haridwar district. No voter statement or appreciation found in any source for this AC; this is a guess about what voters value.

positives.english: * Sugarcane is the main crop here, and many families depend on farming for their income
positives.hindi: * गन्ना यहाँ की मुख्य फसल है, और ज़्यादातर परिवार खेती पर निर्भर हैं
positives.basis: Inference: Tribune (1 Mar 2021) describes sugarcane as the main grievance and crop across Muzaffarnagar district (district-level). It does not state that this is a positive for Purkazi voters, so this is a placeholder needing a field check.

positives.english: * Being close to Haridwar gives local farmers and traders access to a wider market
positives.hindi: * हरिद्वार से नज़दीकी से किसानों और व्यापारियों को बड़ा बाज़ार मिलता है
positives.basis: Inference: Wikipedia states Purkazi borders Haridwar district in Uttarakhand. No source found on market access or voter views of it. Placeholder needing a field check.

positives.english: * Basic civic services in the town run on a routine basis
positives.hindi: * कस्बे में बुनियादी नागरिक सेवाएँ नियमित रूप से चल रही हैं
positives.basis: Inference: the only Purkazi-specific source found (Amar Ujala 2019) covers sanitation only, and no source on current water, roads or power in the town was found. This is a weak placeholder that must be checked in the field.

negatives.english: Sugar mills have not cleared last season's cane dues, and farmers are left waiting
negatives.hindi: चीनी मिलें पिछले सीज़न का गन्ना बकाया नहीं चुकातीं, किसान इंतज़ार करते रहते हैं
negatives.basis: Tribune (dateline 28 Feb, updated 1 Mar 2021), Muzaffarnagar district-level: farmers say several sugar mills have not cleared last season's dues, and one farmer cited a delay of over a year. Not specific to Purkazi AC; the article does not name Purkazi.

negatives.english: The Makhiyali power house is overloaded, so irrigation power does not come on time
negatives.hindi: मखियाली पावर हाउस पर लोड ज़्यादा है, सिंचाई के समय बिजली नहीं मिलती
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (video report, 20 Mar 2025), Muzaffarnagar district panchayat hall during Kisan Diwas: farmers said the Makhiyali power house has been overloaded for three years, so irrigation power comes late. District-level; the report does not say whether Makhiyali falls in Purqazi AC, which needs checking.

negatives.english: Cane prices have stayed the same for years while farming costs keep rising
negatives.hindi: गन्ने का भाव सालों से वही है, जबकि खेती का खर्च लगातार बढ़ रहा है
negatives.basis: Tribune (1 Mar 2021), Muzaffarnagar district-level: farmers say cane prices have been stagnant for several seasons; FRP rose from Rs 255 to Rs 285 per quintal between 2017-18 and 2020-21; farmers spend over Rs 2 lakh per hectare per season. Not Purkazi-specific.

negatives.english: Smaller fertiliser bags cost more, and stray cattle are also a problem for farmers
negatives.hindi: खाद की बोरियाँ छोटी हो गईं पर दाम ज़्यादा हैं, और आवारा पशु भी परेशान करते हैं
negatives.basis: Tribune (1 Mar 2021), Muzaffarnagar district-level: farmers cited higher fertiliser costs from smaller urea and DAP bags, diesel prices and stray cattle. Not Purkazi-specific.

negatives.english: Overloaded sugarcane trucks cause accidents, and farmers blame officials for not stopping them
negatives.hindi: ओवरलोड गन्ने की गाड़ियों से हादसे होते हैं, किसान अफ़सरों को ज़िम्मेदार ठहराते हैं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (video report, 20 Mar 2025), Muzaffarnagar district panchayat hall: farmers blamed officials for accidents involving overloaded sugarcane vehicles; the Additional DM assured action. District-level; no Purkazi road or accident is named.

notes: Confirmed via Wikipedia: Constituency No. 13, Purqazi, Muzaffarnagar district, SC reserved, Bijnor Lok Sabha. The ECI-spelled name was not checked against the ECI site; the Wikipedia spelling is used. Search budget for this turn ran out after about 14 searches and 10 fetches, so the research is incomplete. Purkazi-specific local grievances (water, roads, drainage, power, health) were NOT found. The only Purkazi-named items are the 2019 ODF Plus report, a 2020 cannon-case report (not a grievance), a 2025 kanwar-route incident (law-and-order, deliberately not used as a statement), and a 2023 murder report (not used). Five negatives rely on Muzaffarnagar district-level sources (Tribune 2021, Amar Ujala 2025), so they are not AC-specific; the 2021 Tribune article is dated. Positives 2-5 are inferences with no voter source. Field checks needed: Purkazi nagar panchayat water supply, drainage and garbage; NH 58 traffic and accidents; whether Makhiyali power house is inside Purqazi AC; current cane dues from the Purkazi-area sugar mill; Ganga or canal flooding. Vote figures from Wikipedia were not used, as the brief excludes electoral data.
